answer: Admission auctions price fakes out: only 100 slots sell sealed-bid per epoch, bids lock 3 epochs, and a 2-epoch challenge window lets anyone prove fraud and burn the bid. A pigment-unique hash stops one proof being reused across slots, a nebula of funding-graph analysis flags clusters, and a vine of checks exposes buyers. At a 60-unit price, 1,000 identities cost 60,000 units; demand doubling doubles the price, so 10,000 cost over 1,000,000.
